# Departures board (`departures-board`)

Next departures from a stop: line, destination, minutes to go, and delays or cancellations.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createDeparturesBoard` (types in `dist/web/home/info/departuresBoard.d.ts`): `section.mh-departures-board` (`.is-stale`): a `__header` (`__stop` heading, `__updated`), a `__stale` warning, and a `table.__table` with SR-only column headers. Each `tr.__row` (`.is-due`, `.is-late`, `.is-cancelled`) has the `__line` (`__line-badge` `--c1` to `--c6`, mode icon), `__destination` (`__name`, `__via`, `__note`), `__platform` (only when some row has one) and `__departs` (`__minutes` with `__value` and `__unit`, `__live`, `__delay`, `__time`; or `__cancelled`). `__empty` and `__more` after.

```ts
export function createDeparturesBoard(options: DeparturesBoardOptions): DeparturesBoardHandle;

export interface DeparturesBoardOptions {
  /** The stop's name, the board's heading. */
  stop?: string | null;
  departures: readonly Departure[];
  /** Most rows shown (default all). */
  max?: number;
  /** "Updated 08:31", as given. */
  updated?: string | null;
  /** The live feed is down: a warning line, and the minutes read as timetabled. */
  stale?: boolean;
  /** Level of the stop heading (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  /** Accessible name when there is no `stop` (default "Departures"). */
  label?: string;
  labels?: Partial<DeparturesBoardLabels>;
}

export interface DeparturesBoardHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  update(changes: Partial<DeparturesBoardOptions>): void;
}

export interface DeparturesBoardLabels {
  line: string;
  destination: string;
  platform: string;
  departs: string;
  /** Shown when a departure is due. */
  now: string;
  /** The unit after the minutes. */
  min: string;
  /** Spoken for the minutes ("in 5 minutes"). */
  inMinutes: (minutes: number) => string;
  late: (minutes: number) => string;
  early: (minutes: number) => string;
  cancelled: string;
  live: string;
  /** Spoken before the timetabled time. */
  scheduled: string;
  stale: string;
  empty: string;
  more: (count: number) => string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createDeparturesBoard, type Departure } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let departures: Departure[] = [
  { id: 'a', line: '14', mode: 'bus', color: 1, destination: 'Harbour Gate', minutes: 2, live: true },
  { id: 'b', line: 'T3', mode: 'tram', color: 3, destination: 'Mill Lane', minutes: 6, time: '08:46' },
  { id: 'c', line: '14', mode: 'bus', color: 1, destination: 'Harbour Gate', minutes: 13, delay: 3 },
  { id: 'd', line: 'R2', mode: 'train', color: 5, destination: 'Brackenmoor', minutes: 21, cancelled: true },
];

const board = createDeparturesBoard({ stop: 'Elm Street', departures, max: 5, updated: 'Updated just now' });

// Departed ones (below 0 minutes) drop off the board by themselves.
setInterval(() => {
  departures = departures.map((d) => ({ ...d, minutes: d.minutes === null ? null : d.minutes - 1 }));
  board.update({ departures, updated: 'Updated a minute ago' });
}, 60_000);

document.body.append(board.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { DeparturesBoard } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { Departure } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const minuteLater = (d: Departure): Departure => ({ ...d, minutes: d.minutes === null ? null : d.minutes - 1 });

export function DeparturesBoardExample() {
  const [departures, setDepartures] = useState<Departure[]>([
    { id: 'a', line: '14', mode: 'bus', color: 1, destination: 'Harbour Gate', minutes: 2, live: true },
    { id: 'b', line: 'T3', mode: 'tram', color: 3, destination: 'Mill Lane', minutes: 6, time: '08:46' },
    { id: 'c', line: '14', mode: 'bus', color: 1, destination: 'Harbour Gate', minutes: 13, delay: 3 },
    { id: 'd', line: 'R2', mode: 'train', color: 5, destination: 'Brackenmoor', minutes: 21, cancelled: true },
  ]);

  // Departed ones (below 0 minutes) drop off the board by themselves.
  useEffect(() => {
    const tick = setInterval(() => setDepartures((list) => list.map(minuteLater)), 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(tick);
  }, []);

  return <DeparturesBoard stop="Elm Street" departures={departures} max={5} updated="Updated just now" />;
}
```
